gloss_en: Browser clash and version-diff tool: how to diff IFC versions when Revit and Archicad regenerate GlobalIds, and how to group clashes
title_original: Browser-based IFC clash + version diff: how would you group clashes and handle GUID churn?
question_paraphrase: Revit regenerates GlobalIds for some categories so a GlobalId-only diff makes everything look deleted and re-added; planned fallback is matching orphans by IfcType, geometry hash and centroid proximity. Is that sensible? Also is a PDF/HTML changelog worth sending or does BCF cover it?
phrasing_notes: developer voice, numbered sub-questions, product pitch embedded, phrase 'GUID churn'
answer_summary: No replies captured on the page; the approach of matching by type, geometry hash and proximity mirrors what maintainers suggest elsewhere.

gloss_en: Is there any identifier other than GlobalId to tell that an object's geometry is unchanged between file versions, since authoring tools regenerate GlobalIds weekly?
title_original: IfcOpenShell / Python - get_local_placement for .ifcElementAssembly
question_paraphrase: any other identifier than GlobalId to know an object's geometry is unchanged between versions? the authoring tool regenerates the GlobalIds every week, only geometric extents matter
phrasing_notes: short, practical, states constraint up front
answer_summary: No separate identifier; compare bounding boxes with tolerance, or an IfcDiff-like pairing by placement or a geometry tree (as in IfcClash), because IfcDiff itself relies on GlobalIds.

gloss_en: Proposal for an IFC merge tool so teams can branch and merge native IFC with git; sequential STEP ids and header timestamps collide
title_original: [IFC Merge] Proposal: IFC merge tool
question_paraphrase: two people branch the same IFC and both create entity #12346, git cannot merge; FILE_NAME timestamp conflicts; same-entity attribute edits need field-level merge
phrasing_notes: technical proposal with examples, tagged [IFC Merge]
answer_summary: ifcmerge was built for merging forks of the same IFC file; works only with native editors that preserve ids, not export/import round-trips.

gloss_en: Can existing elements with the same GUID be overwritten to support incremental IFC exports from Revit, and how to handle modified or deleted elements?
title_original: merge IFCs
question_paraphrase: could elements with matching GUIDs be overwritten (using owner history) so incremental exports from Revit merge into the main file? does merge mean replace or deep-remove modified/deleted elements, and check dependencies?
answer_summary: Possible in theory (how a reload would work); use IfcDiff to find modified elements because proprietary software does not track owner history reliably; deep removal is complex (root.remove_product).

answer_summary: Confirmed as bug; reported as IfcOpenShell issue 8905 and fixed in July 2026.

gloss_en: After Archicad exports a revised IFC, how can the already imported model be updated without manual diff or full reimport while keeping Blender materials?

phrasing_notes: compares with Lumion and Speckle behavior
answer_summary: Removed earlier incremental import feature; a barebones Reload was added using old.ifc and new.ifc; later users report duplicates when merging by class even with same GlobalID.

gloss_en: Announcement of an IFC version-tracking app: re-export can change STEP numbers and sometimes GlobalIds without changing the building, so text diff is noisy

gloss_en: Federated export of host plus linked model gives IfcGuids that differ from the ones returned by ExportIFCUtils and shown in UI

question_paraphrase: model and linked model exported into same IfcSite give IfcGuids in the file that differ from the GUIDs reported by the API/UI
answer_summary: By design: each link instance needs its own GUID, so linked wall GUID differs from standalone export; discussion moved to issue 880.

gloss_en: Deleting an IfcGuid of a room or level regenerates the same value every export; no way to get a truly new random GUID
title_original: If you delete an IfcGuid (e.g. of a room or a level), always the same IfcGuid will be created again
question_paraphrase: delete IfcGUID of Room 1, export, same GUID comes back every time, even after save-as; are IFC GUIDs derived from a hidden Revit GUID? copied files end up with identical GUIDs
phrasing_notes: argues defeats purpose of a GUID
answer_summary: Intentional: GUIDs are deterministically calculated; persistent GUID is a buildingSMART certification requirement; workaround is a macro to assign random GUIDs.

gloss_en: 2,578 duplicate GlobalIds across six IFC files (1.9M elements) from the same project; why are GlobalIds not unique across files?
title_original: Why are GlobalIds not unique across files?
question_paraphrase: found 2,578 duplicate GlobalIds among ~1.9M elements across six architectural IFC files; users copy or split Revit files and duplicates hit storeys, psets, groups
phrasing_notes: precise numbers, practitioner of large federations
answer_summary: Expected: unique within a project but can repeat across copied/split files; script GUID regeneration or edit IfcGUID parameter; Reset Document GUID needs Revit core change.

gloss_en: IFC element types: same Revit type ID appears several times with different Type IfcGUIDs

answer_summary: Consistent-GUID work shipped in Revit 2023.1; open-source add-in update needed; Revit 2021 not updated.

gloss_en: Elements in the primary design option lose their IfcGuid when another option becomes primary; breaks BCF tracking

gloss_en: Converting between Revit UniqueId and IFC GUID in C#
title_original: RevitのUniqueIdとIFCのGUIDとの変換

phrasing_notes: blog tutorial in Japanese with C# sample
answer_summary: Four rules: imported IFC GUID kept; 1:1 elements use episode-id GUID XOR element id; entities without counterpart use Detach GUID XOR element id; others random.
